concerns.text: The plan states “No open Materials Project structure data: the requirement for crystal‑graph descriptors (FR‑002) cannot be satisfied with an openly downloadable source.” This means the cited PCM parquet dataset provides only compositional information and lacks crystal structure files needed to generate the required graph features. FR‑002 is a mandatory functional requirement (“System MUST compute … crystal graph representations using pymatgen's StructureGraph module”). Relying on a fallback to composition‑only descriptors does not satisfy the requirement and renders the methodology unable to answer the research question about governing structural factors.
